logros.nombre: Wipe That Smirk Off Your Face
logros.descripcion: Defeat Ronald after defeating 2 GR members!
Defeat Ronald in the GR Grass Fortress!
Defeat Ronald in either the GR Fire Fortress or the GR Water Fortress!
Defeat Ronald in the GR Castle!
Complete the first step of Aaron's training regimen!
Complete the second step of Aaron's training regimen!
Complete the third step of Aaron's training regimen!
Without loading a save or losing, defeat Pawn, Knight, Bishop, Rook, and Queen consecutively at the Game Center!
Without saving during the battle, defeat Axel by taking every prize card without ever knocking out his active Pokémon!
Without saving during battle, defeat Magician by taking every prize card without ever dealing more than 20 damage in a single attack!
Without saving during the battle, defeat Warren by taking every prize card after playing at least 15 Trainer cards!
Without saving during the battle, defeat Pierrot by using Moltres' Wildfire to reduce his deck down to 0 cards!
Without saving during the battle, defeat Toby by taking every prize card without your active Pokémon ever getting poisoned!
Without saving during the battle, defeat Frank by using Pidgeot's Hurricane while he has no Pokémon on the bench!
Without saving during the battle, defeat Masquerade by deck-out without taking any prize cards!

logros.nombre: Blow Away Anna with a Bigger Eggsplosion
logros.descripcion: Without saving during the battle, defeat Anna after dealing at least 300 damage in one turn by using Exeggutor's Big Eggsplosion!

logros.nombre: Give Mary's Rain Dance a Chance
logros.descripcion: Without saving during the battle, defeat Mary without playing any cards after the initial setup until your fifth turn!
Record all 443 cards into the album!
